title: Butterflies TASTE with their FEET?! 🦋 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. says animals can't fool him… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: Butterflies taste with their feet: taste sensors (chemoreceptors) on their feet let them taste a leaf by standing on it.
Three-toed sloths climb down from their tree to poop only about once a week.
Koalas have fingerprints that look almost exactly like human fingerprints.
